name: io.github.willianpinho/mcp-gateway-scan
description: Read-only static scanner for MCP/agent-gateway production-readiness anti-patterns, exposed as an MCP tool (scan_gateway). Scores a repo across 7 security dimensions. Never executes code, never makes network calls, never prints secret values.
title: MCP Gateway Scan

packageArguments.description: Run as a stdio MCP server exposing the read-only scan_gateway tool (instead of the default one-shot CLI scan).
